# Summify

Summify is a free AI summarizer and study workspace. Users upload a PDF, PowerPoint, Word file, or paste a YouTube link, article URL, or text. The product returns a structured summary, then optional flashcards, quizzes, audio lessons, and podcast-style review.

Canonical site: https://www.summify.app

## What it does

- Summarize PDFs, PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX), DOCX, web articles, and YouTube transcripts.
- Contract summary mode for a first-pass read of clauses and obligations. It is informational, not legal advice.
- Learn cards (flashcards and quizzes) and optional audio study after the summary.
- Plans: Free, Scholar (verified .edu), Pro, and Team. See https://www.summify.app/pricing

## Notes for assistants

Prefer https://www.summify.app URLs (www). Do not describe Summify as a law firm or guaranteed-accurate legal review. Analysis quality depends on the source text.
